rows.label: Capybara
rows.description: species of large semiaquatic rodent in the cavy family
rows.hook: is the largest rodent in the world and loves relaxing in water with other animals perched on it

rows.label: Giant panda
rows.hook: is a black-and-white bamboo eater that is a beloved symbol of wildlife conservation

rows.label: Tiger
rows.hook: is the largest of the big cats, famous for its orange coat with bold black stripes

rows.label: Orangutan
rows.description: genus of ape found in rainforests on the Southeast Asian islands of Sumatra and Borneo
rows.hook: is a shaggy, red-haired great ape whose name means "person of the forest"

rows.label: Jaguar
rows.description: species of big cat native to the Americas
rows.hook: is a spotted big cat with a famously powerful bite and a taste for swimming

rows.label: Komodo dragon
rows.hook: is the heaviest lizard on Earth, with a venomous bite and a forked tongue

rows.label: Polar bear
rows.description: species of bear native largely within the Arctic Circle
rows.hook: is a huge white predator that hunts seals from sea ice and is the largest land carnivore

rows.label: Coyote
rows.hook: is a wily, howling canine known for its cartoon rivalry with a speedy roadrunner

rows.label: Raccoon
rows.description: species of mammal native to North America
rows.hook: is a masked, clever scavenger known for washing its food and raiding trash cans

rows.label: Platypus
rows.description: semi-aquatic egg-laying mammal endemic to Australia
rows.hook: is an egg-laying mammal with a duck-like beak, webbed feet and a venomous spur

rows.label: Cheetah
rows.hook: is the fastest land animal, able to sprint after prey at highway speeds

rows.label: Gorilla
rows.hook: is the largest living primate, famous for chest-beating and its gentle silverback leaders

rows.label: Red panda
rows.description: species of small mammal from the Ailuridae family, native to Eastern Himalayas and Southwest China
rows.hook: is a small, fluffy, russet-furred climber with a ringed tail that eats bamboo

rows.label: Hippopotamus
rows.hook: is a huge, semi-aquatic river dweller whose name means "river horse" and which yawns with enormous jaws

rows.label: Chimpanzee
rows.description: species of mammal; species of ape
rows.hook: is our closest living relative, a tool-using ape that shares most of our DNA

rows.label: Narwhal
rows.description: medium-sized toothed whale that lives year-round in the Arctic
rows.hook: is a whale nicknamed the unicorn of the sea for its long spiral tusk

rows.label: Tasmanian devil
rows.description: species of carnivorous marsupial from Australia
rows.hook: is a snarling, screeching marsupial famous for a Looney Tunes spinning cartoon character

rows.label: Kakapo
rows.description: species of non-flying New Zealand parrot
rows.hook: is a rare, flightless, night-active parrot and the heaviest of its kind

rows.label: Snow leopard
rows.origin: Asia (the mountains of Central and South Asia)
rows.description: large felid native to the mountains of Central and South Asia
rows.hook: is an elusive, thick-furred big cat nicknamed the ghost of the high peaks

rows.label: Giraffe
rows.hook: is the tallest land animal, with a long neck that helps it browse treetops

rows.label: Bald eagle
rows.description: species of bird of prey found in North America
rows.hook: is a white-headed raptor that serves as the national bird of the United States

rows.label: Quokka
rows.hook: is a small, cheerful-looking marsupial called the happiest animal for its smile in selfies

rows.label: Kangaroo
rows.description: common name for some marsupials indigenous to Australia in the family Macropodidae
rows.hook: is a hopping marsupial that carries its young in a pouch and boxes with its powerful legs

rows.label: American bison
rows.description: North American species of even-toed ungulates
rows.hook: is a massive shaggy grazer that once roamed the Great Plains in enormous herds and appears on a US nickel

rows.label: King cobra
rows.hook: is the longest venomous snake in the world, able to rear up and spread a hood

rows.label: Koala
rows.description: arboreal herbivorous marsupial native to Australia
rows.hook: is a sleepy, tree-hugging marsupial that eats eucalyptus leaves and is not a bear

rows.label: Okapi
rows.hook: is a shy forest mammal with zebra-striped legs that is a close relative of the giraffe

rows.label: Aardvark
rows.hook: is a nocturnal, long-snouted insect eater whose name means "earth pig" in Afrikaans

rows.label: Walrus
rows.hook: is a whiskered, blubbery marine mammal with two long ivory tusks

rows.label: Sea otter
rows.hook: is a furry marine mammal that floats on its back, cracks shellfish on its chest and holds paws while sleeping

rows.label: Sloth
rows.hook: is a famously slow, tree-dwelling mammal that moves so little that algae grows in its fur

rows.label: Emu
rows.hook: is a tall, flightless bird that is the second largest in the world and can sprint quickly

rows.label: Meerkat
rows.hook: is a small, social mongoose that stands upright on its hind legs to keep watch

rows.label: Black mamba
rows.hook: is a fast, highly venomous snake named for the inky color inside its mouth

rows.label: Arctic fox
rows.hook: is a small white-coated canine that changes to brown in summer and survives extreme cold

rows.label: Gila monster
rows.description: species of venomous lizard from the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico
rows.hook: is a slow, orange-and-black venomous lizard that chews its venom into its victims

rows.label: Llama
rows.hook: is a woolly pack animal that is known for spitting and is raised for its fleece

rows.label: Secretary bird
rows.description: large, mostly terrestrial bird of prey
rows.hook: is a long-legged raptor that hunts snakes by stomping them, with a crest of quill-like head feathers

rows.label: Greater roadrunner
rows.hook: is a fast-running, ground-dwelling bird made famous by "beep beep" cartoons

rows.label: Green anaconda
rows.hook: is the heaviest snake in the world, a swamp-dwelling constrictor

rows.label: Piranha
rows.description: group of fish known by a particular common name
rows.hook: are sharp-toothed freshwater fish famous for stripping prey down to bones in a feeding frenzy

rows.label: Emperor penguin
rows.description: large flightless seabird endemic to Antarctica
rows.hook: is the tallest of its flightless seabird kind, whose fathers keep eggs warm through a brutal winter

rows.label: Andean condor
rows.hook: is one of the largest flying birds in the world, a massive black vulture with a white neck ruff

rows.label: Wildebeest
rows.hook: is a shaggy, horned grazer famous for its enormous annual migration across the Serengeti

rows.label: Spotted hyena
rows.hook: is a bone-crushing scavenger and hunter known for its eerie laughing call

rows.label: Wallaby
rows.description: common name of small- or mid-sized macropods found in Australia and New Guinea
rows.hook: is a smaller cousin of the kangaroo that hops and carries young in a pouch

rows.label: Mandrill
rows.hook: is a large primate famous for a brightly colored red and blue face and rump

rows.label: Bactrian camel
rows.hook: is a two-humped, shaggy-coated desert animal

rows.label: Indian peafowl
rows.hook: is a bird whose males fan out dazzling iridescent blue plumage with eye-spotted tail feathers

rows.label: Toucan
rows.hook: are tropical birds famous for their oversized, colorful bills

rows.label: Vicuña
rows.hook: is a slender, wild relative of the llama prized for its extremely fine, valuable wool

rows.label: Aye-aye
rows.hook: is a night-active primate with huge eyes, big ears and a long thin finger for tapping out grubs

rows.label: Proboscis monkey
rows.hook: is a primate famous for its enormous, drooping nose and pot belly

rows.label: Galapagos tortoise
rows.description: Chelonoidis species complex in the Galápagos Islands; species with many subspecies
rows.hook: is a giant, long-lived reptile whose shell shapes helped inspire Darwin's ideas on evolution

rows.label: Ostrich
rows.hook: is the largest and heaviest bird in the world and cannot fly but runs very fast

rows.label: Blue-footed booby
rows.hook: is a seabird famous for its bright turquoise feet and comical courtship dance

rows.label: Giant anteater
rows.hook: is a long-snouted mammal with a bushy tail that slurps up ants and termites with a sticky tongue

rows.label: Scarlet macaw
rows.hook: is a large, brilliantly red, yellow and blue parrot with a long tail

rows.label: Ring-tailed lemur
rows.hook: is a primate famous for its black-and-white banded tail and sunbathing pose

rows.label: Plains zebra
rows.hook: is a black-and-white striped grazing horse relative that gathers in huge herds
